name: c6 flee: shot choice (no flee code change)
written: 2026-10-31, before any reader saw the sheets
question: Does a flee/leave staged on a medium (waist-up) shot read worse than the same deed on a full-body shot? Current production flee code (2.0), same scenes, same frames.
sheets: medium-ltt, medium-cra (r12) vs full-ltt, full-cra (r8 arm A); neutral names s1..s4
readers: 5 fresh blind sonnet readers per sheet, one sheet each, no narration: what does the person do across the frames
scoring: a separate judge per description: RUNS_AWAY (runs / flees / dashes off), WALKS_AWAY (walks / leaves at a walk), MOVES_UNCLEAR (slides / drifts / disappears / leans, no gait), STAYS
rule: If medium RUNS_AWAY (pooled, /10) is at least 2 below full-body RUNS_AWAY (/10), storyboard merge REFUSES flee/leave on any non-full-body shot (today only closeUp is refused) and suggests wide. Otherwise no change.
